newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 8.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French cut-price clothing retailer, Tati, is to open franchises at the SOCOCE supermarket chain in Ivory Coast, creating between 200 and 300 jobs.

- SITARAIL, which operates the rail line between Abidjan and Kaya in Burkina Faso, calls in an advertisement for tenders for work to improve premises, including those used by passengers. The European Investment Bank has given a loan for the work.

- French Cooperation Minister Charles Josselin is in Ivory Coast on Tuesday. On the agenda, when he meets government ministers, will be France's review of its defence agreements with several African countries.

- Over 400 workers have lost their jobs at the privatised palm oil producer, Palmindustrie, and compensation payments are far lower than those obtained by people who opted for voluntary redundancy at the time of the privatisation.
- The government announces in an advertisement the privatisation of its public works equipment department.
